Mime Jr.

Psychic Fairy

Sinnoh · Generation 4 · Baby Pokémon

Mime Jr. is a Psychic/Fairy-type Mime Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 13 kg. It evolves into Mr. Mime. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (90), with a base stat total of 310.
